title: Always broadcast alerts to the dashboard, whether or not Telegram is configured

options.name: Keep current behaviour
options.risk: Alerts sent through sendTelegramAlert never reach the dashboard when Telegram is not configured, and always show as info (AUD-DB-018).

options.name: Broadcast first, then try Telegram; infer severity in both senders
options.behavior_impact: The dashboard feed shows every alert with its severity.
options.risk: Under the test rails the broadcast runs where it was skipped before (D-04 amended already expects the catch path).

default: Keep current behaviour until the owning phase decides (milestone contract); S3.
behavior_impact: Decides whether the dashboard depends on Telegram for alerts.
